ProfileReady.title: Profile

board.hint: Technical tasks are never created or edited by humans: they follow the solicitation → demand → task chain, driven by the chief. To ask for something new, create a solicitation in the chat.

noProject.body: The board shows a project's tasks. Create your first project to get started.

instruction.title: Instruction sent to the agent

actions.title: Human actions
actions.explain: You don't create or edit technical tasks — they follow the solicitation → demand → task chain, driven by the chief. Here you can reprioritize, pause, cancel, request review and decide gates. To ask for something new, use the chat.
actions.pauseNote: Paused by the user on the board.
actions.cancelNote: Cancelled by the user on the board; back to the backlog for the chief to re-plan.
actions.reviewNote: Review requested by the user on the board.
actions.error: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
actions.archiveOnlyDone: Only completed tasks can be archived.

archive.batchBody: {{count}} completed task(s) will be archived. They leave the default board, but history is preserved and they remain accessible via the "Archived" filter.
archive.error: Could not archive. Please try again.

flow.title: How work flows
flow.intro: Tasks advance through the columns in this order:
flow.blockedNote: is transversal: it can happen from any column (external dependency, manual pause) and, once resolved, the task resumes to its origin column.

human.pause: Pause (the task goes to Blocked with a pause note)
human.cancel: Cancel (returns to Backlog for the chief to re-plan)
human.gate: Approve or reject gates and documents (rejection requires a note)

flow.agentsTitle: What the chief and agents do

agents.create: Create tasks from the solicitation → demand → task chain
agents.move: Move tasks across columns as work progresses
agents.execute: Execute the work (attempts with evidence, cost and tokens)
agents.unblock: Unblock and fix (In corrections) after rejections

mode.title: Operation mode

description.manual: Every gate and transition waits for your decision.
description.semiautonomous: Agents advance on their own; only the selected gates pause for approval.
description.autonomous: Agents execute and approve gates with no human intervention.

risk.manual: In manual mode, no gate advances without your approval. Slower, but fully under your control.
risk.semiautonomous: In semi-autonomous mode, agents advance phases and gates on their own, except at the gates you choose to pause. You are accountable for delegated decisions.
risk.autonomous: In autonomous mode, agents execute and approve gates with no human intervention, including releases. The operational risk is entirely yours.

mode.pauseGatesLabel: Gates that pause for human approval
mode.notePlaceholder: Why do you accept this mode now?
mode.acceptCheckbox: I have read and accept the risks of this operation mode
